## Description

Second adapter for the UAE provider (decision recorded) and a "card on terminal" method recording terminal batch reference without card data; insurer co-pay collection.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Provider choice recorded in an ADR; adapter passes the same contract tests as Razorpay.
- [ ] **AC2.** Card-on-terminal records reference and amount only and reconciles in day close.
- [ ] **AC3.** Co-pay collection is linked to the insurer-pending invoice.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
